History:("Xue Yang is a demonic cultivator who was in the service of the Lanling Jin sect and is responsible for the slaughter to the Yueyang Chang clan. Xue Yang is described as a young man with a boyish charm, who looks like nothing more than a child. His canine teeth show when he smiles, and, with bright eyes, a high nasal bridge, a beaming smile and thin lips that have a soft red hue, he can be described as handsome.He is quite tall (180 cm) even as a junior disciple, and his eyes are full of casual disdain.From his youth, Xue Yang was known as a delinquent in Kuizhou, famous for his beaming smile, inhuman acts and ruthless personality. This seems to have stemmed from a traumatic incident during his childhood, as he was previously naive and trusting.However, when he is a junior disciple of the Lanling Jin Clan, Xue Yang views the cultivators around him with contempt and shows no fear in the presence of the intimidating Nie Mingjue. Xue Yang is a witty, sharp and intelligent young man who, besides Wei Wuxian, is the only person who could restore the other half of the Yin Tiger Tally. He seems particularly sensitive to the idea of people looking down on him, often reacting with murderous intent. He tends to hold grudges and retaliates with extreme and ruthless measure, killing without age or gender discrimination, and even taking advantage of Xiao Xingchen's blindness by using it to massacre villagers as revenge against Xiao Xingchen. Xue Yang is extremely cautious, as he denies caring about anyone, even during his final fight, despite significant evidence that he had cared about Xiao Xingchen.In his later youth, Xue Yang becomes famous for his delinquency in Kuizhou, He was sadistic due to his experiences of child abuse as a child. Xue Yang demonstrates a skill with words several times, especially in his fight with Song Lan . He becomes calmer as the battle progresses and uses his sharp words to distress and distract Song Lan . This creates an opportunity to bathe him with the corpse toxin and cut out his tongue. Xue Yang also uses his skills with words against Xiao Xingchen when the latter confronts him about his true identity. Xue Yang is shown to be able to endure an unusual amount of pain. He still talks and laughs as usual while being stabbed in the stomach, and also fends off Lan Wangji despite multiple wounds.")
